requirements.text: You're a product-minded Machine Learning Engineer who enjoys building real systems people depend on. You'll likely have:
Proven track record of shipping ML systems in production, with real users and high uptime
Experience developing advanced AI systems, particularly those that deconstruct complex tasks into manageable steps
Strong analytical sense: you build frameworks to measure the metrics that matter and iterate quickly from real usage
Ownership mindset: you drive projects end-to-end and thrive on problems that don't have clean answers yet
Enjoy following SOTA research into new models and agent architectures.
